en.t: The door of Gongbei Tower stood open.

units.source_text: 像往常一样，可以望见壁龛挂着圆山应举的画轴，还摆设着用植香木雕成的刻功精细而纤巧的舶来佛龛。

en.t: As usual, one could see a hanging scroll by Maruyama Okyo in the alcove, and there was also an imported Buddhist shrine, finely and delicately carved from aloeswood.

units.source_text: 由于年长月久，色泽都变黑了。

en.t: With the long passage of years, all their colors had darkened.

units.source_text: 左边可以看到利休喜爱的桑木百宝架，也可以看见阳扇壁画。

en.t: On the left one could see the mulberry display shelf beloved by Rikyu, and also the wall painting of the sun fan.

units.source_text: 惟独看不见老师的影子。

en.t: Only the old master's figure was nowhere to be seen.

units.source_text: 我不由得翘首越过篱笆环视了四周。

en.t: I could not help craning my neck over the fence and looking all around.
